articles.title: DOJ summons Robin Padilla, 6 others over Bato Dela Rosa escape
articles.description: The Department of Justice has issued a subpoena against Sen. Robin Padilla and six others over complaints of obstruction of justice.
articles.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Justice (DOJ) has issued a subpoena against Sen. Robin Padilla and six others over complaints of obstruction of justice. According to the summons, Padilla is required to appear before the DOJ on September 25 and October 9. The summons were served on the lawmaker and co-accused Lt. Col. Jean Alla Yasin Robles on Tuesday afternoon, according to DOJ Spokesperson Polo Martinez. The complaints are over his alleged assistance in the escape of Sen. Bato Dela Rosa on May 14, following the shooting incident at the Senate. It could be recalled that Dela Rosa hitched a ride in Padilla’s SUV on May 14 before disappearing from law enforcement’s radar. Padilla also admitted that he gave Dela Rosa a ride to help him escape. The DOJ complaint was filed by the Philippine National Police Criminal Investigation and Detection Group on May 28. A separate complaint of obstruction of justice was also filed before the Office of the Ombudsman against Padilla. The obstruction complaint against Padilla at the Ombudsman was filed by civic group Tindig Pilipinas on July 4. In a Facebook post, Padilla said: "A subpoena has arrived." Dela Rosa, who is wanted by the International Criminal Court, is currently at large due to alleged crimes against humanity. articles.text: MANILA — Sen. Robinhood Padilla said Monday he was “not a traitor” and that he was only asserting the sovereignty of the Philippines. Padilla is facing an obstruction of justice complaint for his alleged assistance in the disappearance of Sen. Ronald Dela Rosa, who is wanted by the International Criminal Court over his role in the Duterte administration’s war on drugs. “Hindi ako traydor sa Pilipinas. Ang tanong ko: sino ba talaga ang traydor? Ang tumitindig para sa kalayaan at soberanya ng kanyang bayan, o ang handang ipaubaya sa dayuhan ang paghusga at pagdidikta sa mga Pilipino?” Padilla said in a press release. “Hindi natin isusuko ang ating soberanya. Napakaraming Pilipino ang lumaban at nagsakripisyo para sa bansang ito. Ang pagtatanggol sa kalayaan ng Pilipinas ay hindi pagtataksil—ito ay tungkulin.” NBI summons Robin Padilla’s aide, uncle over Dela Rosa disappearance Dela Rosa has been absent from public eye since last year, before he turned up at the Senate to register a crucial vote that installed new Senate President Alan Peter Cayetano. Padilla said the change in the chamber’s leadership had nothing to do with Vice President Sara Duterte’s upcoming Senate impeachment trial. “Kapag nakarating sa Senado ang impeachment, walang makakapigil diyan. Malinaw sa Konstitusyon at sa Rules ng Senado na kailangan kaming mag-convene bilang impeachment court,” he said. “Ginawa po namin iyon para sa Blue Ribbon Committee, upang malaman ng taumbayan ang katotohanan at upang masiguro na may pananagutan ang mga dapat managot,” he added. Marcoleta to resume Senate probe on flood control corruption on June 4 Senate President Alan Peter Cayetano has said a Blue Ribbon subcommittee will be formed and will be led by Senator Rodante Marcoleta, one of the vice chairpersons of the committee. The flood control probe will resume on June 4.

articles.title: Robin Padilla files resolution seeking to junk Sara Duterte impeachment | ABS-CBN News
articles.description: Sen. Robinhood Padilla on Monday confirmed that he has a separate resolution seeking to dismiss the impeachment case of Vice President Sara Duterte.

text.preview: MANILA (UPDATED) — Sen. Robinhood Padilla on Monday confirmed he has filed separate resolution seeking to dismiss the impeachment case of Vice President Sara Duterte. articles.title: SALN ug basura
articles.description: Gikan sa kapin sa P7 milyones sa tuig 2007 misaka ngadto kapin sa P98 milyones ang kinatibuk-ang bahandi ni Bise Presidente Sarah Duterte basi sa iyang gisumitir nga Statements of Assets Liabilities and Networth sa buhatan sa Ombudsman.
articles.text: Gikan sa kapin sa P7 milyones sa tuig 2007 misaka ngadto kapin sa P98 milyones ang kinatibuk-ang bahandi ni Bise Presidente Sarah Duterte basi sa iyang gisumitir nga Statements of Assets Liabilities and Networth sa buhatan sa Ombudsman. Kining P98M nga networth limpiyo na kini nga bahandi sa Bise Presidente tungod kay gikuhaan na kini sa mga liabikities sa iyang kinatibokan nga assets. Ang pagsangat og SALN gimando kini sa balaud sa tanang mga kawani og opisyal sa gobyerno sa tuyo nga subayon ang dagan sa ilang bahandi aron makita wala ba sila nagpadato samtang nangalagad sa gobiyerno. Mao kini ang rason ngano nga gipresentar isip ebidensiya sa prosecution alang sa kaso nga unexplained wealth ang SALN sa bise presidente nga dako ang paglubo gikan sa iyang pagka mayor hangtod napili siya nga bise presidente. Pero wala ba hunahunaa sa prosecution nga kun ang SALN nga gisumitir sa opisyal o kawani sa gobiyerno segurado gayod nga ang maong opisyal makapasabot niini? Kun ikaw ang pangutan-on mosumitir kaha ka og SALN nga dili ka makaisplikar o makapasabot? Gikonsiderar karon sa lokal nga kagamhanan sa dakbayan sa Sugbo ang paglabay sa basura niini sa dakbayan sa Toledo human wala na moapil sa bidding ang Prime Waste Solutions human gidiskuwalipay sa BAC kay expired na ang Philgeps registrations. Kun dili man diay ko makalabay sa akong basura sa labayanan nga naa mahimotang sa akong dakbayan mas maayo pa nga ako kining pasirad-an. articles.title: DOJ summons Robin Padilla, 6 others over Bato Dela Rosa escape
articles.description: The Department of Justice has issued a subpoena against Sen. Robin Padilla and six others over complaints of obstruction of justice.
articles.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Justice (DOJ) has issued a subpoena against Sen. Robin Padilla and six others over complaints of obstruction of justice. According to the summons, Padilla is required to appear before the DOJ on September 25 and October 9. The summons were served on the lawmaker and co-accused Lt. Col. Jean Alla Yasin Robles on Tuesday afternoon, according to DOJ Spokesperson Polo Martinez. The complaints are over his alleged assistance in the escape of Sen. Bato Dela Rosa on May 14, following the shooting incident at the Senate. It could be recalled that Dela Rosa hitched a ride in Padilla’s SUV on May 14 before disappearing from law enforcement’s radar. Padilla also admitted that he gave Dela Rosa a ride to help him escape. The DOJ complaint was filed by the Philippine National Police Criminal Investigation and Detection Group on May 28. A separate complaint of obstruction of justice was also filed before the Office of the Ombudsman against Padilla. The obstruction complaint against Padilla at the Ombudsman was filed by civic group Tindig Pilipinas on July 4. In a Facebook post, Padilla said: "A subpoena has arrived." Dela Rosa, who is wanted by the International Criminal Court, is currently at large due to alleged crimes against humanity. text.preview: Naghain si Sen. Robinhood Padilla ng Senate Bill 2730 na naglalayong ipagbawal ang mga political dynasty. Wala pang isang buwan ang nakaraan, sinabi ni Padilla na “magandang balita” ang pagtakbo nina dating pangulong Rodrigo Duterte at ang kanyang dalawang anak na lalaki, sina Davao City Rep. Paolo Duterte at Davao City Mayor Sebastian Duterte, sa 2025 senatorial race. Wala pang isang buwan matapos sabihin na ang pagkakaroon ng tatlong Duterte sa 2025 senatorial race ay “magandang balita,” naghain si Sen. Robinhood Padilla ng panukalang batas na nagbabawal sa political dynasties . article.description: Wala pang isang buwan matapos sabihin na ang pagkakaroon ng tatlong Duterte sa 2025 senatorial race ay "magandang balita," naghain si Sen. Robinhood Padilla ng panukalang batas na nagbabawal sa political dynasties.

text.preview: Naghain si Sen. Robinhood Padilla ng Senate Bill 2730 na naglalayong ipagbawal ang mga political dynasty. Wala pang isang buwan ang nakaraan, sinabi ni Padilla na “magandang balita” ang pagtakbo nina dating pangulong Rodrigo Duterte at ang kanyang dalawang anak na lalaki, sina Davao City Rep. Paolo Duterte at Davao City Mayor Sebastian Duterte, sa 2025 senatorial race. Wala pang isang buwan matapos sabihin na ang pagkakaroon ng tatlong Duterte sa 2025 senatorial race ay “magandang balita,” naghain si Sen. Robinhood Padilla ng panukalang batas na nagbabawal sa political dynasties . Ang panukalang anti-political dynasty ni Padilla ay nagbabawal sa mga miyembro ng pamilya o mga kamag-anak na tumakbo para sa anumang elective office sa parehong lungsod at/o probinsya, o anumang party list sa parehong halalan. Bahagi ng panukala ni Padilla, na inihain noong Hulyo 15 at naka-log bilang Senate Bill 2730, ay nagsabi na: “No spouse or person related within the fourth degree of consanguinity or affinity, whether legitimate or illegitimate, full or half blood, to an incumbent elective official seeking reelection, shall be allowed to hold or run for any elective office in the same city and/or province, or any party list in the same election.” (“ Walang asawa o taong may kaugnayan sa loob ng ikaapat na antas ng consanguinity o affinity , lehitimo man o hindi lehitimo , buo o kalahating dugo , sa isang nanunungkulan na ibinoto na opisyal na naghahangad na muling mahalal , ay dapat payagang humawak o tumakbo para sa alinmang elective office sa parehong lungsod at/ o probinsya , o anumang party list sa parehong halalan .”) Pinagmulan: Sen. article.title: Robin Padilla says he’s no ‘traitor’ | ABS-CBN News
article.description: Sen. Robinhood Padilla said Monday he was “not a traitor” and that he was only asserting the sovereignty of the Philippines.
article.text: MANILA — Sen. Robinhood Padilla said Monday he was “not a traitor” and that he was only asserting the sovereignty of the Philippines. Padilla is facing an obstruction of justice complaint for his alleged assistance in the disappearance of Sen. Ronald Dela Rosa, who is wanted by the International Criminal Court over his role in the Duterte administration’s war on drugs. “Hindi ako traydor sa Pilipinas. Ang tanong ko: sino ba talaga ang traydor? Ang tumitindig para sa kalayaan at soberanya ng kanyang bayan, o ang handang ipaubaya sa dayuhan ang paghusga at pagdidikta sa mga Pilipino?” Padilla said in a press release. “Hindi natin isusuko ang ating soberanya. Napakaraming Pilipino ang lumaban at nagsakripisyo para sa bansang ito. Ang pagtatanggol sa kalayaan ng Pilipinas ay hindi pagtataksil—ito ay tungkulin.” NBI summons Robin Padilla’s aide, uncle over Dela Rosa disappearance Dela Rosa has been absent from public eye since last year, before he turned up at the Senate to register a crucial vote that installed new Senate President Alan Peter Cayetano. Padilla said the change in the chamber’s leadership had nothing to do with Vice President Sara Duterte’s upcoming Senate impeachment trial. “Kapag nakarating sa Senado ang impeachment, walang makakapigil diyan. Malinaw sa Konstitusyon at sa Rules ng Senado na kailangan kaming mag-convene bilang impeachment court,” he said. “Ginawa po namin iyon para sa Blue Ribbon Committee, upang malaman ng taumbayan ang katotohanan at upang masiguro na may pananagutan ang mga dapat managot,” he added. Marcoleta to resume Senate probe on flood control corruption on June 4 Senate President Alan Peter Cayetano has said a Blue Ribbon subcommittee will be formed and will be led by Senator Rodante Marcoleta, one of the vice chairpersons of the committee. The flood control probe will resume on June 4.

article.title: Robin Padilla files resolution seeking to junk Sara Duterte impeachment | ABS-CBN News
article.description: Sen. Robinhood Padilla on Monday confirmed that he has a separate resolution seeking to dismiss the impeachment case of Vice President Sara Duterte.

text.preview: MANILA (UPDATED) — Sen. Robinhood Padilla on Monday confirmed he has filed separate resolution seeking to dismiss the impeachment case of Vice President Sara Duterte. In Senate Resolution 1371, Padilla noted that “all pending matters and proceedings will terminate upon the expiration of one Congress” once the 19th Congress adjourns sine die on Friday, June 13. "The Articles of Impeachment against Vice-President Sara Zimmerman Duterte is one such pending matter, and the consideration thereof is one such pending proceeding," he said. Padilla earlier said his resolution is his own and has nothing to do with other similar resolutions. He also said he did not consult the vice president about it. "May kaniya-kaniya kaming isip, may kaniya-kaniya kaming gawa, may kaniya-kaniya kaming staff," he said. Sen. Ronald "Bato" dela Rosa earlier admitted to initiating a similar resolution. Critics and lawyers had pointed out that dismissing the impeachment case of Duterte was not part of the process, and the Senate should hold the trial immediately, as mandated by the 1987 Constitution. A member of the House prosecution panel had even called a possible Senate dismissal of the impeachment case " unconstitutional ." article.title: Robin Padilla says he believes in Christian communism, Muslim Muakhat
article.description: Sen. Robin Padilla on Thursday explained the communism he believed in – Christian communism and the Muslim Muakhat – a day after telling a witness in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte that he was a communist.

text.preview: Sen. Robin Padilla on Thursday explained the communism he believed in – Christian communism and the Muslim Muakhat – a day after telling a witness in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte that he was a communist. On Facebook, Padilla said he no longer believed in the communism that advocated armed struggle. "Itong armadong komunismo na ito ay 50 taon na sa ating bansa,napakaraming buhay na ang nawala una na ang mga kabataang estudyante na nahimok mamundok.Hindi na ito ang komunismo na aking tinutukoy," Padilla said. (This armed communism has existed in our country for 50 years, and so many lives have already been lost—first and foremost, the young students who were enticed to go to the mountains. This is no longer the communism I am referring to.) "Ang sinasabi ko na komunismo ay hindi ang komunismo na ito na dati kong pinaniwalaan, ang komunismo na aking sinabi ay ang lolo ng komunismo ni Karl Marx. 'Yan po ay ang mga unang Kristiyano at unang mga Muslim na nagsagawa nito sa Madinah," he added. "Ang tawag po diyan sa kanila ay Christian communism, at sa mga Muslim ay Mu’tah system. Ito po ang mga tunay na socialist at communist practice," Padilla said. (The communism I am talking about is not the communism that I once believed in. The communism I referred to is the grandfather of communism by Karl Marx. That refers to the early Christians and the early Muslims who practiced it in Medina. What they called it was Christian communism, and for Muslims, the Mu’akhat system. These are the true socialist and communist practices.) text.preview: Senator Robin Padilla and several other senators should recuse themselves from the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte, a member of the Movement of Concerned Citizens for Civil Liberties (MCCCL) on Monday said. In a press conference at the UP Diliman, MCCCL spokesperson Atty. Kasi gumawa na kayo ng ano eh, ng desisyon eh, na hindi pa niyo nakikita officially ‘yung dokumento at hindi niyo pa nakikita officially ‘yung ebidensya,” Lacanilao said. (Senator Robinhood and the other senators who are blocking it, recuse yourselves. Because you already made a decision without officially seeing the document, without seeing the evidence.) In response, Padilla said it was better to await the decision of the Supreme Court on the impeachment. "Maraming salamat po sa mungkahi ng MCCCL. Mainam po sa ngayon ay antayin ang magiging desisyon ng Kataastaasang Hukom patungkol sa impeachment," Padilla told GMA News Online. Last week, lawyer Catalino Generillo Jr. asked the SC to compel the Senate to “immediately” convene as an impeachment court, arguing that the Constitution does not permit the Senate to delay its duty during recess. On Monday, the high court said the petition has been raffled . This may be included in the SC's agenda on Tuesday, February 18 along with other petitions. Kining P98M nga networth limpiyo na kini nga bahandi sa Bise Presidente tungod kay gikuhaan na kini sa mga liabikities sa iyang kinatibokan nga assets. Ang pagsangat og SALN gimando kini sa balaud sa tanang mga kawani og opisyal sa gobyerno sa tuyo nga subayon ang dagan sa ilang bahandi aron makita wala ba sila nagpadato samtang nangalagad sa gobiyerno. Mao kini ang rason ngano nga gipresentar isip ebidensiya sa prosecution alang sa kaso nga unexplained wealth ang SALN sa bise presidente nga dako ang paglubo gikan sa iyang pagka mayor hangtod napili siya nga bise presidente. Pero wala ba hunahunaa sa prosecution nga kun ang SALN nga gisumitir sa opisyal o kawani sa gobiyerno segurado gayod nga ang maong opisyal makapasabot niini? Kun ikaw ang pangutan-on mosumitir kaha ka og SALN nga dili ka makaisplikar o makapasabot? Gikonsiderar karon sa lokal nga kagamhanan sa dakbayan sa Sugbo ang paglabay sa basura niini sa dakbayan sa Toledo human wala na moapil sa bidding ang Prime Waste Solutions human gidiskuwalipay sa BAC kay expired na ang Philgeps registrations. Kun dili man diay ko makalabay sa akong basura sa labayanan nga naa mahimotang sa akong dakbayan mas maayo pa nga ako kining pasirad-an. article.title: DOJ summons Robin Padilla, 6 others over Bato Dela Rosa escape
article.description: The Department of Justice has issued a subpoena against Sen. Robin Padilla and six others over complaints of obstruction of justice.
article.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Justice (DOJ) has issued a subpoena against Sen. Robin Padilla and six others over complaints of obstruction of justice. According to the summons, Padilla is required to appear before the DOJ on September 25 and October 9. The summons were served on the lawmaker and co-accused Lt. Col. Jean Alla Yasin Robles on Tuesday afternoon, according to DOJ Spokesperson Polo Martinez. The complaints are over his alleged assistance in the escape of Sen. Bato Dela Rosa on May 14, following the shooting incident at the Senate. It could be recalled that Dela Rosa hitched a ride in Padilla’s SUV on May 14 before disappearing from law enforcement’s radar. Padilla also admitted that he gave Dela Rosa a ride to help him escape. The DOJ complaint was filed by the Philippine National Police Criminal Investigation and Detection Group on May 28. A separate complaint of obstruction of justice was also filed before the Office of the Ombudsman against Padilla. The obstruction complaint against Padilla at the Ombudsman was filed by civic group Tindig Pilipinas on July 4. In a Facebook post, Padilla said: "A subpoena has arrived." Dela Rosa, who is wanted by the International Criminal Court, is currently at large due to alleged crimes against humanity. article.title: FACT CHECK: Sen. Robinhood Padilla bumaligtad sa isyu ng political dynasties
article.description: Wala pang isang buwan matapos sabihin na ang pagkakaroon ng tatlong Duterte sa 2025 senatorial race ay "magandang balita," naghain si Sen. Robinhood Padilla ng panukalang batas na nagbabawal sa political dynasties.

text.preview: Naghain si Sen. Robinhood Padilla ng Senate Bill 2730 na naglalayong ipagbawal ang mga political dynasty. Wala pang isang buwan ang nakaraan, sinabi ni Padilla na “magandang balita” ang pagtakbo nina dating pangulong Rodrigo Duterte at ang kanyang dalawang anak na lalaki, sina Davao City Rep. Paolo Duterte at Davao City Mayor Sebastian Duterte, sa 2025 senatorial race. Wala pang isang buwan matapos sabihin na ang pagkakaroon ng tatlong Duterte sa 2025 senatorial race ay “magandang balita,” naghain si Sen. Robinhood Padilla ng panukalang batas na nagbabawal sa political dynasties . Ang panukalang anti-political dynasty ni Padilla ay nagbabawal sa mga miyembro ng pamilya o mga kamag-anak na tumakbo para sa anumang elective office sa parehong lungsod at/o probinsya, o anumang party list sa parehong halalan. Bahagi ng panukala ni Padilla, na inihain noong Hulyo 15 at naka-log bilang Senate Bill 2730, ay nagsabi na: “No spouse or person related within the fourth degree of consanguinity or affinity, whether legitimate or illegitimate, full or half blood, to an incumbent elective official seeking reelection, shall be allowed to hold or run for any elective office in the same city and/or province, or any party list in the same election.” (“ Walang asawa o taong may kaugnayan sa loob ng ikaapat na antas ng consanguinity o affinity , lehitimo man o hindi lehitimo , buo o kalahating dugo , sa isang nanunungkulan na ibinoto na opisyal na naghahangad na muling mahalal , ay dapat payagang humawak o tumakbo para sa alinmang elective office sa parehong lungsod at/ o probinsya , o anumang party list sa parehong halalan .”) Pinagmulan: Sen. article.title: Robin Padilla says he’s no ‘traitor’ | ABS-CBN News
article.description: Sen. Robinhood Padilla said Monday he was “not a traitor” and that he was only asserting the sovereignty of the Philippines.
article.text: MANILA — Sen. Robinhood Padilla said Monday he was “not a traitor” and that he was only asserting the sovereignty of the Philippines. Padilla is facing an obstruction of justice complaint for his alleged assistance in the disappearance of Sen. Ronald Dela Rosa, who is wanted by the International Criminal Court over his role in the Duterte administration’s war on drugs. “Hindi ako traydor sa Pilipinas. Ang tanong ko: sino ba talaga ang traydor? Ang tumitindig para sa kalayaan at soberanya ng kanyang bayan, o ang handang ipaubaya sa dayuhan ang paghusga at pagdidikta sa mga Pilipino?” Padilla said in a press release. “Hindi natin isusuko ang ating soberanya. Napakaraming Pilipino ang lumaban at nagsakripisyo para sa bansang ito. Ang pagtatanggol sa kalayaan ng Pilipinas ay hindi pagtataksil—ito ay tungkulin.” NBI summons Robin Padilla’s aide, uncle over Dela Rosa disappearance Dela Rosa has been absent from public eye since last year, before he turned up at the Senate to register a crucial vote that installed new Senate President Alan Peter Cayetano. Padilla said the change in the chamber’s leadership had nothing to do with Vice President Sara Duterte’s upcoming Senate impeachment trial. “Kapag nakarating sa Senado ang impeachment, walang makakapigil diyan. Malinaw sa Konstitusyon at sa Rules ng Senado na kailangan kaming mag-convene bilang impeachment court,” he said. “Ginawa po namin iyon para sa Blue Ribbon Committee, upang malaman ng taumbayan ang katotohanan at upang masiguro na may pananagutan ang mga dapat managot,” he added. Marcoleta to resume Senate probe on flood control corruption on June 4 Senate President Alan Peter Cayetano has said a Blue Ribbon subcommittee will be formed and will be led by Senator Rodante Marcoleta, one of the vice chairpersons of the committee. The flood control probe will resume on June 4.

article.title: Robin Padilla files resolution seeking to junk Sara Duterte impeachment | ABS-CBN News
article.description: Sen. Robinhood Padilla on Monday confirmed that he has a separate resolution seeking to dismiss the impeachment case of Vice President Sara Duterte.

text.preview: MANILA (UPDATED) — Sen. Robinhood Padilla on Monday confirmed he has filed separate resolution seeking to dismiss the impeachment case of Vice President Sara Duterte. In Senate Resolution 1371, Padilla noted that “all pending matters and proceedings will terminate upon the expiration of one Congress” once the 19th Congress adjourns sine die on Friday, June 13. "The Articles of Impeachment against Vice-President Sara Zimmerman Duterte is one such pending matter, and the consideration thereof is one such pending proceeding," he said. Padilla earlier said his resolution is his own and has nothing to do with other similar resolutions. He also said he did not consult the vice president about it. "May kaniya-kaniya kaming isip, may kaniya-kaniya kaming gawa, may kaniya-kaniya kaming staff," he said. Sen. Ronald "Bato" dela Rosa earlier admitted to initiating a similar resolution. Critics and lawyers had pointed out that dismissing the impeachment case of Duterte was not part of the process, and the Senate should hold the trial immediately, as mandated by the 1987 Constitution. A member of the House prosecution panel had even called a possible Senate dismissal of the impeachment case " unconstitutional ." article.title: Robin Padilla says he believes in Christian communism, Muslim Muakhat
article.description: Sen. Robin Padilla on Thursday explained the communism he believed in – Christian communism and the Muslim Muakhat – a day after telling a witness in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte that he was a communist.

text.preview: Sen. Robin Padilla on Thursday explained the communism he believed in – Christian communism and the Muslim Muakhat – a day after telling a witness in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte that he was a communist. On Facebook, Padilla said he no longer believed in the communism that advocated armed struggle. "Itong armadong komunismo na ito ay 50 taon na sa ating bansa,napakaraming buhay na ang nawala una na ang mga kabataang estudyante na nahimok mamundok.Hindi na ito ang komunismo na aking tinutukoy," Padilla said. (This armed communism has existed in our country for 50 years, and so many lives have already been lost—first and foremost, the young students who were enticed to go to the mountains. This is no longer the communism I am referring to.) "Ang sinasabi ko na komunismo ay hindi ang komunismo na ito na dati kong pinaniwalaan, ang komunismo na aking sinabi ay ang lolo ng komunismo ni Karl Marx. 'Yan po ay ang mga unang Kristiyano at unang mga Muslim na nagsagawa nito sa Madinah," he added. "Ang tawag po diyan sa kanila ay Christian communism, at sa mga Muslim ay Mu’tah system. Ito po ang mga tunay na socialist at communist practice," Padilla said. (The communism I am talking about is not the communism that I once believed in. The communism I referred to is the grandfather of communism by Karl Marx. That refers to the early Christians and the early Muslims who practiced it in Medina. What they called it was Christian communism, and for Muslims, the Mu’akhat system. These are the true socialist and communist practices.) During Tuesday's impeachment trial, Padilla admitted to being a communist while questioning National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Regional Director Jeremy Lotoc regarding "Oplan Romanov." article.title: Robin Padilla, others urged to recuse from Sara Duterte impeachment trial
article.description: Senator Robin Padilla and several other senators should recuse themselves from the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte, a member of the Movement of Concerned Citizens for Civil Liberties (MCCCL) on Monday said.

text.preview: Senator Robin Padilla and several other senators should recuse themselves from the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte, a member of the Movement of Concerned Citizens for Civil Liberties (MCCCL) on Monday said. In a press conference at the UP Diliman, MCCCL spokesperson Atty. Jojo Lacanilao asked this of senators “who prejudged” the impeachment trial. “Kailangan si Senator Robinhood mag-recuse at ‘yung ibang senador na nagpipigil, mag-recuse kayo. Kasi gumawa na kayo ng ano eh, ng desisyon eh, na hindi pa niyo nakikita officially ‘yung dokumento at hindi niyo pa nakikita officially ‘yung ebidensya,” Lacanilao said. (Senator Robinhood and the other senators who are blocking it, recuse yourselves. Because you already made a decision without officially seeing the document, without seeing the evidence.) In response, Padilla said it was better to await the decision of the Supreme Court on the impeachment. "Maraming salamat po sa mungkahi ng MCCCL. Mainam po sa ngayon ay antayin ang magiging desisyon ng Kataastaasang Hukom patungkol sa impeachment," Padilla told GMA News Online. Last week, lawyer Catalino Generillo Jr. asked the SC to compel the Senate to “immediately” convene as an impeachment court, arguing that the Constitution does not permit the Senate to delay its duty during recess. On Monday, the high court said the petition has been raffled . This may be included in the SC's agenda on Tuesday, February 18 along with other petitions. In January, Padilla said he stood by the UniTeam and that he would “definitely” vote no to impeaching Duterte. Lacanilao said this was an affront to the 1987 Constitution. “Teka muna, napakalapastangan naman sa Constitution niyan. Gawin mo ‘yung trabaho mo. Hindi ‘yung prine-prejudged mo na. Hindi mo na titignan ‘yung ebidensya,” he said. (Wait a second, this is an affront to the Constitution. Do your job. You shouldn’t prejudge it yet. Look at the evidence.) article.title: SALN ug basura
article.description: Gikan sa kapin sa P7 milyones sa tuig 2007 misaka ngadto kapin sa P98 milyones ang kinatibuk-ang bahandi ni Bise Presidente Sarah Duterte basi sa iyang gisumitir nga Statements of Assets Liabilities and Networth sa buhatan sa Ombudsman.
article.text: Gikan sa kapin sa P7 milyones sa tuig 2007 misaka ngadto kapin sa P98 milyones ang kinatibuk-ang bahandi ni Bise Presidente Sarah Duterte basi sa iyang gisumitir nga Statements of Assets Liabilities and Networth sa buhatan sa Ombudsman. Kining P98M nga networth limpiyo na kini nga bahandi sa Bise Presidente tungod kay gikuhaan na kini sa mga liabikities sa iyang kinatibokan nga assets. Ang pagsangat og SALN gimando kini sa balaud sa tanang mga kawani og opisyal sa gobyerno sa tuyo nga subayon ang dagan sa ilang bahandi aron makita wala ba sila nagpadato samtang nangalagad sa gobiyerno. Mao kini ang rason ngano nga gipresentar isip ebidensiya sa prosecution alang sa kaso nga unexplained wealth ang SALN sa bise presidente nga dako ang paglubo gikan sa iyang pagka mayor hangtod napili siya nga bise presidente. Pero wala ba hunahunaa sa prosecution nga kun ang SALN nga gisumitir sa opisyal o kawani sa gobiyerno segurado gayod nga ang maong opisyal makapasabot niini? Kun ikaw ang pangutan-on mosumitir kaha ka og SALN nga dili ka makaisplikar o makapasabot? Gikonsiderar karon sa lokal nga kagamhanan sa dakbayan sa Sugbo ang paglabay sa basura niini sa dakbayan sa Toledo human wala na moapil sa bidding ang Prime Waste Solutions human gidiskuwalipay sa BAC kay expired na ang Philgeps registrations. Kun dili man diay ko makalabay sa akong basura sa labayanan nga naa mahimotang sa akong dakbayan mas maayo pa nga ako kining pasirad-an. article.title: DOJ summons Robin Padilla, 6 others over Bato Dela Rosa escape
article.description: The Department of Justice has issued a subpoena against Sen. Robin Padilla and six others over complaints of obstruction of justice.
article.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Justice (DOJ) has issued a subpoena against Sen. Robin Padilla and six others over complaints of obstruction of justice. According to the summons, Padilla is required to appear before the DOJ on September 25 and October 9. The summons were served on the lawmaker and co-accused Lt. Col. Jean Alla Yasin Robles on Tuesday afternoon, according to DOJ Spokesperson Polo Martinez. The complaints are over his alleged assistance in the escape of Sen. Bato Dela Rosa on May 14, following the shooting incident at the Senate. It could be recalled that Dela Rosa hitched a ride in Padilla’s SUV on May 14 before disappearing from law enforcement’s radar. Padilla also admitted that he gave Dela Rosa a ride to help him escape. The DOJ complaint was filed by the Philippine National Police Criminal Investigation and Detection Group on May 28. A separate complaint of obstruction of justice was also filed before the Office of the Ombudsman against Padilla. The obstruction complaint against Padilla at the Ombudsman was filed by civic group Tindig Pilipinas on July 4. In a Facebook post, Padilla said: "A subpoena has arrived." Dela Rosa, who is wanted by the International Criminal Court, is currently at large due to alleged crimes against humanity. output.title: Robin Padilla says he believes in Christian communism, Muslim Muakhat
output.description: Sen. Robin Padilla on Thursday explained the communism he believed in – Christian communism and the Muslim Muakhat – a day after telling a witness in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte that he was a communist.
output.text: Sen. Robin Padilla on Thursday explained the communism he believed in – Christian communism and the Muslim Muakhat – a day after telling a witness in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte that he was a communist. On Facebook, Padilla said he no longer believed in the communism that advocated armed struggle. "Itong armadong komunismo na ito ay 50 taon na sa ating bansa,napakaraming buhay na ang nawala una na ang mga kabataang estudyante na nahimok mamundok.Hindi na ito ang komunismo na aking tinutukoy," Padilla said. (This armed communism has existed in our country for 50 years, and so many lives have already been lost—first and foremost, the young students who were enticed to go to the mountains. This is no longer the communism I am referring to.) "Ang sinasabi ko na komunismo ay hindi ang komunismo na ito na dati kong pinaniwalaan, ang komunismo na aking sinabi ay ang lolo ng komunismo ni Karl Marx. 'Yan po ay ang mga unang Kristiyano at unang mga Muslim na nagsagawa nito sa Madinah," he added. "Ang tawag po diyan sa kanila ay Christian communism, at sa mga Muslim ay Mu’tah system. Ito po ang mga tunay na socialist at communist practice," Padilla said. (The communism I am talking about is not the communism that I once believed in. The communism I referred to is the grandfather of communism by Karl Marx. That refers to the early Christians and the early Muslims who practiced it in Medina. What they called it was Christian communism, and for Muslims, the Mu’akhat system. These are the true socialist and communist practices.) During Tuesday's impeachment trial, Padilla admitted to being a communist while questioning National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Regional Director Jeremy Lotoc regarding "Oplan Romanov." Padilla said that "Operation Romanov" should be seen as a threat targeting the nation's prominent anti-communist leaders—specifically including both the Marcos and Duterte families—which means the vice president could also be at risk. The senator's statement just came after fellow actor Angel Locsin called him out for his controversial remark. "Ang tanong ko lang, nasaan ka nung panahong nirered-tag ako kahit alam mong hindi totoo? Actually, kasama mo pa nga at katsikahan 'yung mga nagre-red-tag. Naghugas-kamay at pumikit sa katotohanan," asked Locsin. (My question is, where were you when I was being red-tagged, even though you knew it wasn't true? In fact, you were even associating and chatting with the very people doing the red-tagging. You washed your hands of the matter and turned a blind eye to the truth.) Locsin also recalled how Padilla himself told her about his experience "fighting for the country in the mountains." "Nung mga panahong magkasama tayo, madalas mong ikuwento 'yung panahon na namundok ka at nag-armas para ipaglaban ang bayan. Sabi mo pa nga, dinadalaw ka ng ex mo sa bundok," Locsin said. (Back then, you would often tell stories about the time you went to the mountains and took up arms to fight for the country. You even mentioned that your ex used to visit you there.) –NB GMA News

output.title: Robin Padilla files resolution seeking to junk Sara Duterte impeachment | ABS-CBN News
output.description: Sen. Robinhood Padilla on Monday confirmed that he has a separate resolution seeking to dismiss the impeachment case of Vice President Sara Duterte.
output.text: MANILA (UPDATED) — Sen. Robinhood Padilla on Monday confirmed he has filed separate resolution seeking to dismiss the impeachment case of Vice President Sara Duterte. In Senate Resolution 1371, Padilla noted that “all pending matters and proceedings will terminate upon the expiration of one Congress” once the 19th Congress adjourns sine die on Friday, June 13. "The Articles of Impeachment against Vice-President Sara Zimmerman Duterte is one such pending matter, and the consideration thereof is one such pending proceeding," he said. Padilla earlier said his resolution is his own and has nothing to do with other similar resolutions. He also said he did not consult the vice president about it. "May kaniya-kaniya kaming isip, may kaniya-kaniya kaming gawa, may kaniya-kaniya kaming staff," he said. Sen. Ronald "Bato" dela Rosa earlier admitted to initiating a similar resolution. Critics and lawyers had pointed out that dismissing the impeachment case of Duterte was not part of the process, and the Senate should hold the trial immediately, as mandated by the 1987 Constitution. A member of the House prosecution panel had even called a possible Senate dismissal of the impeachment case " unconstitutional ." Ex-SC justice: VP Sara impeachment trial can continue in 20th Congress but must start in 19th Padilla and Dela Rosa are drafting resolutions seeking to dismiss the impeachment case even after several senators, members of the academe, and political analysts called on the Senate to "forthwith proceed" with the trial. Ateneo schools, Adamson, UST join call for Senate to start Sara Duterte impeachment trial The House of Representatives impeached Duterte on February 5 for "high crimes" including corruption and an alleged assassination plot against former ally and running mate President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. Senate President Francis "Chiz" Escudero had announced that the prosecution panel's scheduled presentation at the Senate would be moved to June 11 instead of June 2, citing the tackling of "priority legislative measures before the 19th Congress adjourns" as the reason for the postponement. Individual members of the University of the Philippines College of Law Faculty said Tuesday in an open letter that the Senate's possible dismissal of the impeachment case "without hearing even a single witness will mean its abandonment of its proud tradition as an august chamber and permanently alter our system of checks and balances." "Respectfully, a dismissal at this point would be deemed by the Filipino people as effectively engineered by the Senate's own delay and an abdication of its constitutional role in impeachment," they said. output.description: Sen. Robinhood Padilla said Monday he was “not a traitor” and that he was only asserting the sovereignty of the Philippines.
output.text: MANILA — Sen. Robinhood Padilla said Monday he was “not a traitor” and that he was only asserting the sovereignty of the Philippines. Padilla is facing an obstruction of justice complaint for his alleged assistance in the disappearance of Sen. Ronald Dela Rosa, who is wanted by the International Criminal Court over his role in the Duterte administration’s war on drugs. “Hindi ako traydor sa Pilipinas. Ang tanong ko: sino ba talaga ang traydor? Ang tumitindig para sa kalayaan at soberanya ng kanyang bayan, o ang handang ipaubaya sa dayuhan ang paghusga at pagdidikta sa mga Pilipino?” Padilla said in a press release. “Hindi natin isusuko ang ating soberanya. Napakaraming Pilipino ang lumaban at nagsakripisyo para sa bansang ito. Ang pagtatanggol sa kalayaan ng Pilipinas ay hindi pagtataksil—ito ay tungkulin.” NBI summons Robin Padilla’s aide, uncle over Dela Rosa disappearance Dela Rosa has been absent from public eye since last year, before he turned up at the Senate to register a crucial vote that installed new Senate President Alan Peter Cayetano. Padilla said the change in the chamber’s leadership had nothing to do with Vice President Sara Duterte’s upcoming Senate impeachment trial. “Kapag nakarating sa Senado ang impeachment, walang makakapigil diyan. Malinaw sa Konstitusyon at sa Rules ng Senado na kailangan kaming mag-convene bilang impeachment court,” he said. “Ginawa po namin iyon para sa Blue Ribbon Committee, upang malaman ng taumbayan ang katotohanan at upang masiguro na may pananagutan ang mga dapat managot,” he added. Marcoleta to resume Senate probe on flood control corruption on June 4 Senate President Alan Peter Cayetano has said a Blue Ribbon subcommittee will be formed and will be led by Senator Rodante Marcoleta, one of the vice chairpersons of the committee. The flood control probe will resume on June 4.

output.title: Robin Padilla, others urged to recuse from Sara Duterte impeachment trial
output.description: Senator Robin Padilla and several other senators should recuse themselves from the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte, a member of the Movement of Concerned Citizens for Civil Liberties (MCCCL) on Monday said.
output.text: Senator Robin Padilla and several other senators should recuse themselves from the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte, a member of the Movement of Concerned Citizens for Civil Liberties (MCCCL) on Monday said. In a press conference at the UP Diliman, MCCCL spokesperson Atty. Jojo Lacanilao asked this of senators “who prejudged” the impeachment trial. “Kailangan si Senator Robinhood mag-recuse at ‘yung ibang senador na nagpipigil, mag-recuse kayo. Kasi gumawa na kayo ng ano eh, ng desisyon eh, na hindi pa niyo nakikita officially ‘yung dokumento at hindi niyo pa nakikita officially ‘yung ebidensya,” Lacanilao said. (Senator Robinhood and the other senators who are blocking it, recuse yourselves. Because you already made a decision without officially seeing the document, without seeing the evidence.) In response, Padilla said it was better to await the decision of the Supreme Court on the impeachment. "Maraming salamat po sa mungkahi ng MCCCL. Mainam po sa ngayon ay antayin ang magiging desisyon ng Kataastaasang Hukom patungkol sa impeachment," Padilla told GMA News Online. Last week, lawyer Catalino Generillo Jr. asked the SC to compel the Senate to “immediately” convene as an impeachment court, arguing that the Constitution does not permit the Senate to delay its duty during recess. On Monday, the high court said the petition has been raffled . This may be included in the SC's agenda on Tuesday, February 18 along with other petitions. In January, Padilla said he stood by the UniTeam and that he would “definitely” vote no to impeaching Duterte. Lacanilao said this was an affront to the 1987 Constitution. “Teka muna, napakalapastangan naman sa Constitution niyan. Gawin mo ‘yung trabaho mo. Hindi ‘yung prine-prejudged mo na. Hindi mo na titignan ‘yung ebidensya,” he said. (Wait a second, this is an affront to the Constitution. Do your job. You shouldn’t prejudge it yet. Look at the evidence.) The House of Representatives impeached Duterte on February 5, with 215 lawmakers endorsing the complaint. The Articles of Impeachment were transmitted to the Senate the same day, with an additional 25 congressmen later signing, bringing the total to 240. Senate President Chiz Escudero, however, said the Senate could only convene as an impeachment court when Congress is in session, meaning the trial would begin when the 20th Congress opens in July. For Lacanilao, the senator is seemingly delaying the impeachment trial. “Forthwith and you're talking about three months? Hindi na forthwith ‘yun, diba? Kaya panawagan natin gampanan ng Senado ‘yung kanilang mga katungkulan para makita talaga natin,” he said. Lacanilao said he is convinced that the evidence against Duterte is strong. “I think ‘yung panawagan na i-convict malakas at malaki ang base. Hindi natin sinasabing tanggalin ‘yung proseso ng conviction sa Senate. Kasama ‘yun. Irespeto natin ang Constitution, padaanan sa Senado, at ‘yung mga senador ang mag de-decide,” he said. (I think the call to convict has basis. We’re not saying that we will do away with the process. That’s part of it. Let’s respect the Constitution, let it go through the Senate, and let the senators decide.) Duterte has repeatedly denied misusing the confidential funds lodged under the Office of the Vice President and the Department of Education, which she formerly headed. The fund misuse was one of the allegations cited in the Articles of Impeachment against Duterte. She said she would discuss the impeachment with her legal team. Meanwhile, Taumbayan Ayaw sa Magnanakaw at Abusado Network Alliance (TAMA NA) convenor Dr. Edelina Dela Paz called on the public to join their rally on February 25 at the People Power Monument in EDSA in commemoration of the People Power. “Kung hindi tayo ang kikibo sino? Kung hindi tayo kikilos, sino? Kung hindi ngayon, kailangan pa? Tama na, sobra na, kumilos na. Magkaisa. Kaunlaran para sa lahat. Pondo sa serbisyo, hindi sa pulitiko,” she said. She also supported the impeachment trial of Duterte and her conviction. —LDF, GMA Integrated News

output.title: SALN ug basura
output.description: Gikan sa kapin sa P7 milyones sa tuig 2007 misaka ngadto kapin sa P98 milyones ang kinatibuk-ang bahandi ni Bise Presidente Sarah Duterte basi sa iyang gisumitir nga Statements of Assets Liabilities and Networth sa buhatan sa Ombudsman.
output.text: Gikan sa kapin sa P7 milyones sa tuig 2007 misaka ngadto kapin sa P98 milyones ang kinatibuk-ang bahandi ni Bise Presidente Sarah Duterte basi sa iyang gisumitir nga Statements of Assets Liabilities and Networth sa buhatan sa Ombudsman. Kining P98M nga networth limpiyo na kini nga bahandi sa Bise Presidente tungod kay gikuhaan na kini sa mga liabikities sa iyang kinatibokan nga assets. Ang pagsangat og SALN gimando kini sa balaud sa tanang mga kawani og opisyal sa gobyerno sa tuyo nga subayon ang dagan sa ilang bahandi aron makita wala ba sila nagpadato samtang nangalagad sa gobiyerno. Mao kini ang rason ngano nga gipresentar isip ebidensiya sa prosecution alang sa kaso nga unexplained wealth ang SALN sa bise presidente nga dako ang paglubo gikan sa iyang pagka mayor hangtod napili siya nga bise presidente. Pero wala ba hunahunaa sa prosecution nga kun ang SALN nga gisumitir sa opisyal o kawani sa gobiyerno segurado gayod nga ang maong opisyal makapasabot niini? Kun ikaw ang pangutan-on mosumitir kaha ka og SALN nga dili ka makaisplikar o makapasabot? Gikonsiderar karon sa lokal nga kagamhanan sa dakbayan sa Sugbo ang paglabay sa basura niini sa dakbayan sa Toledo human wala na moapil sa bidding ang Prime Waste Solutions human gidiskuwalipay sa BAC kay expired na ang Philgeps registrations. Kun dili man diay ko makalabay sa akong basura sa labayanan nga naa mahimotang sa akong dakbayan mas maayo pa nga ako kining pasirad-an. output.description: Wala pang isang buwan matapos sabihin na ang pagkakaroon ng tatlong Duterte sa 2025 senatorial race ay "magandang balita," naghain si Sen. Robinhood Padilla ng panukalang batas na nagbabawal sa political dynasties.
output.text: Naghain si Sen. Robinhood Padilla ng Senate Bill 2730 na naglalayong ipagbawal ang mga political dynasty. Wala pang isang buwan ang nakaraan, sinabi ni Padilla na “magandang balita” ang pagtakbo nina dating pangulong Rodrigo Duterte at ang kanyang dalawang anak na lalaki, sina Davao City Rep. Paolo Duterte at Davao City Mayor Sebastian Duterte, sa 2025 senatorial race. Wala pang isang buwan matapos sabihin na ang pagkakaroon ng tatlong Duterte sa 2025 senatorial race ay “magandang balita,” naghain si Sen. Robinhood Padilla ng panukalang batas na nagbabawal sa political dynasties . Ang panukalang anti-political dynasty ni Padilla ay nagbabawal sa mga miyembro ng pamilya o mga kamag-anak na tumakbo para sa anumang elective office sa parehong lungsod at/o probinsya, o anumang party list sa parehong halalan. Bahagi ng panukala ni Padilla, na inihain noong Hulyo 15 at naka-log bilang Senate Bill 2730, ay nagsabi na: “No spouse or person related within the fourth degree of consanguinity or affinity, whether legitimate or illegitimate, full or half blood, to an incumbent elective official seeking reelection, shall be allowed to hold or run for any elective office in the same city and/or province, or any party list in the same election.” (“ Walang asawa o taong may kaugnayan sa loob ng ikaapat na antas ng consanguinity o affinity , lehitimo man o hindi lehitimo , buo o kalahating dugo , sa isang nanunungkulan na ibinoto na opisyal na naghahangad na muling mahalal , ay dapat payagang humawak o tumakbo para sa alinmang elective office sa parehong lungsod at/ o probinsya , o anumang party list sa parehong halalan .”) Pinagmulan: Sen. Robinhood Padilla, The Anti-Political Dynasty Law , Hulyo 15, 2024 Sa isang media release na inilabas matapos ihain ang panukalang batas, sinabi ng baguhang senador: “Political dynasties, in effect, have exhausted resources to attain economic and political dominance while at the same time compromising political competition and undermining accountability.” (“ Ang political dynasties, sa katunayan , ay umuubos ng resources para makamit ang pang-ekonomiya at pampulitikang pangingibabaw habang kasabay nito ay nakompromiso ang kumpetisyon sa pulitika at pinapahina ang pananagutan .”) Pinagmulan: Senate of the Philippines official website, Sen. Robin Files Anti-Political Dynasty Bill , Hulyo 15, 2024 Si Padilla ang namumuno sa Senate Committee on Constitutional Amendments and Revision of Codes, kung saan ang anti-dynasty bill ay malamang na i-refer. Ikinatuwa ni Padilla ang pahayag ni Vice President Sara Duterte noong Hunyo 25 na ang kanyang ama na si dating pangulong Rodrigo Duterte, kasama ang kanyang mga kapatid na sina Rep. Paolo Duterte at Davao City Mayor Sebastian Duterte, ay tatakbo para sa mga puwesto sa Senado sa 2025 midterm elections. “ Napakagandang balita noon . Para sa akin magkakaroon ako ng mga kakampi sa Senado bukod kay Sen. Bong Go, Sen. [Ronald] Bato [Dela Rosa] saka Sen. [Francis]Tolentino.” Pinagmulan: Twitter account ni Jessica Ann Evangelista (Inquirer.net), WATCH: Sen. Robin Padilla reacts to three Dutertes ‘ plan to run for senator in the next elections , Hunyo 27, 2024 Ipinagbabawal ng 1987 Constitution ang political dynasties, ngunit kailangan ng isang enabling law para maipatupad ito. Sinasabi ng Section 26, Article II: “The State shall guarantee equal access to opportunities for public service and prohibit political dynasties as may be defined by law. (“ Ginagarantiyahan ng Estado ang patas na access sa mga oportunidad para sa serbisyo publiko at ipinagbabawal ang political dynasties na itatakda ng batas .”) Pinagmulan: Senate Electoral Tribunal official website, 1987 Constitution , Peb. 2, 1987 Mula nang magpulong ang 8th Congress noong 1987, may mga pagtatangkang magpasa ng panukalang anti-dynasty, ngunit hindi nagtagumpay ang mga iyon hanggang sa kasalukuyang 19th Congress dahil sa pananatili ng political dynasties sa lahat ng antas ng gobyerno. Ilan sa mga kapansin-pansing panukala para wakasan ang political dynasties ay ang itinaguyod ng yumaong senador na si Miriam Defensor-Santiago noong 2011 , Sen. Grace Poe noong 2016 at Sen. Panfilo Lacson noong 2019 . Sa kasalukuyan, ang lahat ng sangay ng gobyerno ay pinangungunahan ng mga miyembro ng pamilyang politikal , kung saan ang mga pamilyang Marcos at Duterte ang nangunguna sa dalawang nangungunang posisyon sa burukrasya. Sa Senado, higit sa kalahati ng mga puwesto ay inookupahan ng mga miyembro ng political families. (Ang may-akda ay isang mag-aaral sa sining ng komunikasyon sa University of the Philippines Los Baños at ginagawa ang kanyang internship sa VERA Files.) output.title: FACT CHECK: Padilla did NOT admit getting turned on by VP Sara; graphic is FAKE
output.description: A graphic is circulating online claiming that Sen. Robinhood Padilla has admitted getting turned on by Vice President Sara Duterte. This is fake.
output.text: Robinhood Padilla has admitted getting turned on by Sara Duterte. In a March 11 email to VERA Files, Padilla’s camp dismissed the circulating sexual remark attributed to him. SMNI, whose name and logo were used in the quote card, also disowned it. A graphic circulating online claims Sen. Robinhood Padilla, a known ally of the Duterte family, has made a sexual remark on Vice President Sara Duterte. This is fake. The official FB page of Nightline News, a news program of Sonshine Media Network International, whose logo was used in the news card, has disowned it in a March 10 advisory. A reader sent the bogus graphic to the VERA Files Misinformation Tip Line to check the claim’s veracity. VERA Files found the earliest copy of the quote card, which was published on March 9 by a user on FB, Instagram and Threads, saying: “I would be a hypocrite kung di ko aaminin na minsan nal*l*bugan din ako kay Madam VP Inday Sara. Bakla ka kung hindi ka attracted sa beauty and brains tulad ni VP. Yun nga lang tulad ni Cong. Suntay hanggang imagination lang tayo (I would be a hypocrite if I won’t admit that I sometimes get turned on by Madam VP Inday Sara. You must be gay if you’re not attracted to beauty and brains like the VP. But like Cong. Suntay, we can only admire her in our imagination) On March 10, an FB user posted a reel featuring the graphic while criticizing the senator’s alleged remark about the vice president. Another user reposted the news card multiple times on his personal account and four FB groups. Yet another user republished the quote attributed to Padilla using a graphic with a different design and layout on March 11. In a statement sent to VERA Files on March 11, Padilla’s camp categorically said the circulating graphic is “fake news,” adding that the senator “will never make such remarks as [he] holds the vice president and all other women with deep respect.” A cursory search of the entire quote on Google and a quick review of Padilla’s official FB pages show no records or posts containing the sexual remark on the vice president. No media organization has reported on it either. On March 10, SMNI news program Nightline News published an official disclaimer on its FB page, clarifying that the material carrying the spurious statement “did not originate from our office and does not reflect our official statements or positions.” “Any misuse, misrepresentation, or unauthorized use of our logo and official social media materials constitutes a violation and may lead to legal action by SMNI News,” the advisory added, which another SMNI news program, Newsblast , also shared. A reverse image search shows that the original news card was published by Nightline News on Feb. 20, reporting that Padilla said he was ready to serve as campaign manager for Duterte in her presidential bid in the 2028 national election. The fraudulent quote card surfaced after Quezon City Rep. Bong Suntay drew backlash for saying he had a sexual fantasy about actress-host Anne Curtis while defending Duterte’s “imagined” kill threat against President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. during the March 3 impeachment proceedings against the vice president at the House of Representatives. VERA Files has previously debunked other disinformation related to Padilla. The copies of the fake graphic published by three users on FB have so far collectively garnered 2,417 reactions; 1,587 comments; and 126 shares. The video bearing the bogus quote card posted by page Pbbm Reaction Tv (created on Mar. 25, 2023) has received 577 reactions; 148 comments; 147 shares; and 13,000 views as of writing. output.title: DOJ summons Robin Padilla, 6 others over Bato Dela Rosa escape
output.description: The Department of Justice has issued a subpoena against Sen. Robin Padilla and six others over complaints of obstruction of justice.
output.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Justice (DOJ) has issued a subpoena against Sen. Robin Padilla and six others over complaints of obstruction of justice. According to the summons, Padilla is required to appear before the DOJ on September 25 and October 9. The summons were served on the lawmaker and co-accused Lt. Col. Jean Alla Yasin Robles on Tuesday afternoon, according to DOJ Spokesperson Polo Martinez. The complaints are over his alleged assistance in the escape of Sen. Bato Dela Rosa on May 14, following the shooting incident at the Senate. It could be recalled that Dela Rosa hitched a ride in Padilla’s SUV on May 14 before disappearing from law enforcement’s radar. Padilla also admitted that he gave Dela Rosa a ride to help him escape. The DOJ complaint was filed by the Philippine National Police Criminal Investigation and Detection Group on May 28. A separate complaint of obstruction of justice was also filed before the Office of the Ombudsman against Padilla. The obstruction complaint against Padilla at the Ombudsman was filed by civic group Tindig Pilipinas on July 4. In a Facebook post, Padilla said: "A subpoena has arrived." Dela Rosa, who is wanted by the International Criminal Court, is currently at large due to alleged crimes against humanity.
